[[Category:Artificial neural network]]
An '''artificial neuron''' is an elementary computational unit in an [[artificial neural network (ANN)]], loosely inspired by [[biological neuron]]s.<ref>{{#cite:Q3074}}</ref>

== Training ==

During training of an [[artificial neural network (ANN)]], weights and bias of each artificial neuron is adjusted to achieve desired output behaviour.<ref>{{#cite:Q3074}}</ref>
